observations.behavior: Changes the Team lookup to fetch only organization_id, removing project-dependent fields.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces unnecessary ORM field loading and removes a dependency on the team's UUID for registration gating; this could reduce query cost or change behavior if downstream code relied on those removed fields.

observations.behavior: Replaces an old workflow-specific feature flag with a new shared organizational flag. The gate now evaluates against the organization rather than both organization and project separately.
observations.posthog_connection: Shifts control of DuckLake import registration from per-project flags to an organization-level setting, potentially changing which projects are eligible without requiring individual project configuration.

observations.behavior: Restricts the feature evaluation context: no longer includes "project" in the group properties, while retaining the "organization" property.
observations.posthog_connection: Narrows the scope of the feature check to the organization level, possibly simplifying rollout and avoiding unintended cross-project effects during migration.

observations.limitations: Only documentation and one implementation hunk show complete changes; other hunks remove constants but do not demonstrate broader systemic impact. No tests cover failure recovery or compatibility checks across dependent workflows.

review.limitations: Only documentation and one implementation hunk show complete changes; other hunks remove constants but do not demonstrate broader systemic impact. No tests cover failure recovery or compatibility checks across dependent workflows.
review.reason: The diff demonstrates a bounded correctness and reliability improvement: it replaces a multi-group feature-flag setup with a single-organization gating mechanism, removes unnecessary ORM field loading, and updates related documentation and tests accordingly. This is substantive and visible, but does not reach tier 3 because there is no evidence of broader capability expansion or systemic risk reduction across multiple components.
review.posthog_relevance: Changes affect managed warehouse data ingestion and registration workflows, potentially altering eligibility and behavior for customers using DuckLake imports at the organizational level.
review.uncertainty: Documentation-only hunks could hide additional behavioral changes; lack of end-to-end test results makes adoption and compatibility unknown.
